_readme: Curated, citation-backed seed data for the mous (investments) table. Every figure verified against the cited sources on 2026-08-25. Review before loading; edit or delete entries you cannot stand behind. Load with: python scripts/load_seed_data.py Extended 2026-08-25 with 8 researched 2018-2023 entries (incl. one cancelled project, shown honestly). Extended again 2026-08-25 with 10 researched 2013-2017 era entries (incl. wound-down and stalled projects, shown honestly) covering from bifurcation onward.

mous.title: Kia's first Indian car plant at Erramanchi, Penukonda
mous.description: Kia signed an MoU with the AP government in April 2017 for a USD 1.1 billion greenfield plant, with cumulative investment reported at over Rs 12,900 crore. The plant near Penukonda (now Sri Sathya Sai district) began commercial production in 2019, with initial capacity of 300,000 vehicles a year and about 11,000 projected jobs.

citations.claim: Rs 12,900 crore, 11,000 jobs, 3 lakh vehicle capacity
USD 1.1 billion MoU signed April 2017

mous.source_caveat: This figure comes from a newspaper or news agency report, not from a government document. We have not found it in any state or central government publication. Treat it as a reported claim until a government source confirms it.

mous.title: 17.8 MTPA integrated steel plant with captive port at Nakkapalli
mous.description: AM/NS India is building an integrated steel plant at Nakkapalli mandal, Anakapalli district, with Rs 1.36 trillion planned across phases plus Rs 11,198 crore for a captive port — a combined Rs 1,47,162 crore over two phases per state ministers. Phase 1 of 8.2 MTPA targets early 2029, scaling to 17.8 MTPA; foundation stone laid 23 March 2026, with up to 100,000 direct and indirect jobs expected.

mous.title: USD 15 billion, 1 GW AI hub and hyperscale data centres, Visakhapatnam
mous.description: Google announced on 14 October 2025 a USD 15 billion (~Rs 1.35 lakh crore) investment — its largest outside the US — to build its first India AI hub in Visakhapatnam: about 1 GW of data centre capacity across ~600 acres at Tarluvada, Adivivaram and Rambilli, plus a subsea cable gateway and clean energy infrastructure, partnering AdaniConneX and Airtel. Ground was broken 28 April 2026 with completion targeted around September 2028. The ~1.88 lakh direct jobs figure is a state government projection.

mous.title: Green Hydrogen Hub at Pudimadaka — India's first under the National Green Hydrogen Mission

The ~Rs 1,85,000 crore project spans 1,600 acres targeting 20 GW of renewables, 1,500 TPD of green hydrogen and 7,500 TPD of derivatives — the first hub sanctioned under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.

mous.title: Pinnapuram Integrated Renewable Energy Storage Project — 1,680 MW pumped storage + solar + wind

SIPB approved the Rs 19,600-crore investment (~4,230 jobs) in September 2022; Unit 1 achieved wet commissioning in October 2024 and the facility was operating by April 2025.

_sourcing_readme: Every MoU carries source_tier: 'government' (a state or central government publication), 'company' (the investor's own announcement) or 'press' (a newspaper or agency report). Only 'government' entries are the state's own record. The others are shown because the commitments are publicly claimed and readers deserve to see them, but they are labelled as claims and their figures must never be presented as government-confirmed. Entries with date_status 'undated' cannot be assigned to a government's term at all.
